title: What breaks Salah
intro: Some actions and states break the prayer – then we must pray it again.

learn.html: Salah is a strict duty – fard – that Muslims must perform in the prescribed way. Salah is valid when we have made all the preparations and kept all its rules. If something happens that breaks the prayer, it is not valid and we must pray it again.

items: lose our wudu in any way during Salah
leave out any condition of Salah or any of its essential parts (arkan)
turn our chest away from the Qiblah
make movements that do not belong in Salah, so that someone watching would wonder whether we are praying at all
speak words that are not part of Salah – answer a salam or a question, laugh out loud, sigh or groan
clear our throat without need, or eat or drink during Salah – even chewing gum
recite the Qur’an so wrongly that its meaning changes
cry in Salah – unless it is out of devotion and awe before Allah
men and women pray in the same row without a barrier, or a woman stands in front of a man

learn.title: 📖 In the Qur’an
learn.html: Allah warns those who pray but do not perform their prayer as they should. <small>(Qur’an, Al-Ma‘un 107:4–5)</small>

learn.title: ⭐ Remember
learn.html: In Salah we stand before Allah: we keep still, keep our eyes on the place of sajdah and think about what we recite.

practice.title: Does it break Salah?
practice.prompt: Tap everything that breaks Salah, then tap Check.

options.text: ↩️ Turning the chest away from the Qiblah
🤲 Crying out of awe before Allah
options.why: Crying from devotion and awe before Allah does not break Salah.

options.text: 👀 Looking at the place of sajdah
options.why: That is exactly where we should look in Salah.

practice.title: Amir and Selman
practice.prompt: Amir and Selman prayed Dhuhr behind the imam. Which of their actions broke Salah?
bins: Breaks Salah or doesn’t belong in it

items.text: Selman nudged Amir with his elbow
Selman looked around at the wall
Amir pointed and whispered “Shhh, we’re praying”
Amir shook his head in ruku‘
They finished with the salam together
